title: New rule: § 18 No Non-Consensual Content
summary: Non-consensual content is banned and consensual non-consent (CNC) is allowed. Whether anyone in the piece is shown suffering draws the line between open, controlled and banned. The controlled list gains a CNC entry.

title: Pacific Northwest section
summary: A new Sections area opens with a Pacific Northwest page: the PNW Furs Telegram and the Seattle Fur/Pup and Gay Seattle calendars. PNW Furs is also listed among the chats on the Welcome page.

title: Stephie the Deer and Neceet are banned
summary: The character Stephie the Deer and the artist Neceet join the banned list for cub.

title: Lugiem is banned
summary: The artist Lugiem joins the banned list for cub.

title: VRChat Moderation team
summary: Cirrus heads the new team; Jericho and Haskell moderate.

title: VRChat group
summary: The network's VRChat group is listed among the chats on the Welcome page.

title: Cirrus co-heads Discord Moderation
summary: Cirrus joins Nimbus as Head Admin of Discord Moderation.

title: Klauth joins Telegram Moderation
summary: Klauth returns to the roster as an admin on Telegram Moderation. Staff approval of the AshenDerg beware is recorded.

title: AshenDerg: beware and ban
summary: AshenDerg, a second identity of RuneDerg, gets a beware entry and is banned for commissioning and sharing sexual art of underage characters.

title: Basil joins five more teams
summary: Basil is added to five more staff teams.

title: Bewares page
summary: A new page for behaviour patterns the team has verified, starting with Patel: manipulation in private messages.

title: The network is CatShark TreeHouse
summary: The chat is renamed CatShark TreeHouse. The Telegram chat lives at t.me/CatSharkTreeHouse and the Discord server is linked from the Welcome page.

title: Incident 260819 statement
summary: The statement on incident 260819 (Latte v. Reggie) is published.

title: Bans after incident 260819
summary: Patel and Halley are banned, and Latte for one week, following incident 260819.

title: Staff roster reorganized
summary: Owners are Zuri, Cirrus and Nimbus. Teams are organized per platform, each with a Head Admin. Dess, Oggie, Ollie, Kalsie, Edu and Klauth left and Polymorph retired. Basil joins Discord Moderation as an admin and Reggie as a moderator.

title: The wiki opens
summary: The Network Rules become numbered clauses with an amendment log, with new clauses on ethnicity (§ 2.5, § 2.6), civility (§ 4.4, § 4.5), accepted IDs (§ 1.5), the controlled-content lists (§ 13) and limited ex post facto (§ 17). New pages: Moderation Strategy, incident 260819, the ban register, the staff roster, and Banned & Controlled.
